definitions.explanation: A retainer who serves his lord with complete loyalty; a word from feudal history and literature, best known from {忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{忠臣|ちゅうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鑑|かがみ}だ。
examples.english: He is a model of a loyal retainer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら}→忠臣蔵：31064_chuushingura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{赤穂|あこう}{浪士|ろうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧だ。
examples.english: Chūshingura is the story of the rōnin of Akō.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら}→忠臣蔵：31064_chuushingura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: Chūshingura dramas used to be shown on TV a lot at the end of the year.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忠臣|ちゅうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鑑|かがみ}: a model of loyalty
- ⟦{忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら}→忠臣蔵：31064_chuushingura⟧: Chūshingura, the story of the 47 rōnin of Akō

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら}→忠臣蔵：31064_chuushingura⟧ tells how the retainers of the lord of Akō avenged his death in 1703. It is one of the most retold stories in Japan, in kabuki, bunraku, film and year-end TV drama; the raid took place on the 14th day of the 12th month, so the story is linked with December.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家臣|かしん}→家臣：12655_kashin⟧: vassal, retainer (neutral)
- ⟦{家来|けらい}→家来：12397_kerai⟧: follower, retainer
- {逆臣|ぎゃくしん}: a traitorous retainer (the opposite)
